symptom: `mxcli report traceability` on a brain with no plan tells you to run `mxcli brain promote --all`, which fails with 'unknown flag: --all'
cause: The hint was written from memory of a flag promote never had; nothing checked the commands an error message tells you to copy
insight: A copy-paste hint is code the user runs: test it against the cobra command tree (Find + Flags().Lookup) so a renamed or imagined flag fails the build, not the user. Found by following the hint during an end-to-end run
